_about: Kitchen settings. Command-line parameters win over this file; a kitchen.json in the kitchen's state folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\brain-kitchen) wins over this one. Put private things (sous.privateWords) only in the state-folder copy.
_budget: dailyBudgetUsd caps API-equivalent dollars per day. On subscriptions nothing is billed per token; the cap works as a daily usage limit.
_caps: maxLive = orders under way at once (running, waiting on a yes, or past their first step); a new order waits on the rail past it. maxQueued = orders waiting to begin; adds past it are refused (the runaway guard). maxJobs (before 10-23: refuse adds past 100 alive) is read as maxLive. archiveDays = finished (done, closed) orders untouched this long move to jobs\archive\yyyy-MM\.
_sandbox: How the tests, mutate and verify stations run AI-written suites (rust/kitchen-sandbox). auto = Low integrity when kitchen-sandbox.exe is built, the old run-bounded path when not; low / medium = required (not built: those stations hold, exit 10); off = run-bounded. Low cannot write Jordan's files but can still READ them and use the network.
_sandboxMedium: Suites that need what Low integrity denies by design run at Medium (still in the job, with private TEMP/HOME), each with the files that, if a job changed them, put it back to Low. Test-Rgb registers real scheduled tasks. Test-Phase0 is Demo Project's tests\phase0 suite (demo-project): it needs Git's sh.exe (cannot start at Low) and writes scratch files inside its own repo folder, so it runs at Medium, but only while the job changed nothing under .claude/, scripts/ or tests/ (an entry ending in / is a whole folder). A job that does touch those gets Low and the suite fails there, so a person looks. The name is global to the kitchen, not per repo.
_breaker: The Stop-work order (code: breaker, kitchen/backoff-lib.ps1). It opens when, of the last <window> step outcomes since it last closed, at least <min> came in and <rate> or more failed. Then no new work for coolSec; if it opens again within reopenWithinSec of closing, the cool-down is the last one x coolGrowth, never past coolMaxSec. After the cool-down it closes when the window's failure rate is under closeRate, or when one trial step passes; a failed trial step keeps it on with a longer cool-down. One HIGH alert per episode and one 'lifted' note. Until TD-EH-07 it was coolSec 60 with no hysteresis, and it flapped.
_backoff: How long a failed step waits before its retry (kitchen/backoff-lib.ps1, TD-EH-08): floorSec x factor^(retry-1), capped at capSec, then +-jitter (never under the floor or over the cap). 'wait' is for failures that waited on something outside the Yard (CI not reporting, the network, GitHub's API, rate limits); 'code' is for the rest. code: 30 s, 2 min, 8 min, 30 min; wait: 5, 20, 60 min. The number of retries per step is unchanged. Replaces backoffBaseSec (2 s, then 4 s); -BackoffBaseSec on the command line (demos, tests) sets both floors in seconds.
_career: Jordan's one resume source, relative to the career folder (env PASS_CAREER_DIR, else gemini-brain\projects\career). Every resume step (tailor, pack, apply-prep, the locked resume-locked.pdf) reads it as {{resume}} / {{claims}}; an edit to the resume re-renders the locked PDF and makes old apply packets ask for Rebuild.
_recipeDefaults: Replaces a recipe variable's default: {"<recipe>": {"<var>": "value"}}. For personal values (the job scout's focus, where, skills and boards): put them only in the state-folder kitchen.json, never in this file. kitchen/cook.ps1 and pass-app/server.mjs read it; the state-folder copy wins.
_hunt: homeMetro: kitchen/rank-fit.ps1 does not penalise an on-site or hybrid role in this city. Empty = every on-site or hybrid role with no remote option is penalised. Personal: set it in the state-folder kitchen.json.
_suppliers: The cooks. tiers = [model, effort]; an empty model lets that CLI choose. window = usage cap per rolling window (runs). A new supplier: kitchen/cooks/<name>.ps1 plus an entry here and in the menu.

gemini._via: Antigravity CLI (agy); Gemini CLI no longer serves personal accounts

antigravity._via: Claude and GPT-OSS on the Google AI Pro plan, through agy

_menu: For each kind of order, the cooks to try, best first (supplier:tier). private = orders that must stay on this PC. plan on the mid tier since 2026-10-14 (an experiment: Opus planning was ~2/3 of all cost; scoreboard.ps1 judges it, go back to strong if first-try passes drop).
_menuWhy: One note per menu kind: why those cooks in that order. Kept beside menu (not inside it) because every key of menu is an order kind. scoreboard.ps1 shows runs, first-try passes and tokens per model so the routing can be judged by numbers.

menuWhy.plan: Planning is read-only reasoning: Claude mid is strong enough and cheap; Opus-class planning was most of the cost.
menuWhy.code: Builds need reliable tool use and edits. Sonnet on the Google plan first (scoreboard 2026-10-22: 100% ok on 7 runs, 84k tokens/run) before Sonnet on the Claude plan (68% on 47 runs, 201k tokens/run): a 2-week trial from 10-22, the scoreboard decides; then Gemini strong. A size L order moves Claude to its strong tier (Opus). The local model never builds (0% first try, n=4).
menuWhy.research: Web research and long reading suit Gemini first: big context and a separate Google quota.
menuWhy.check: Checks read a lot and judge little: Gemini mid first (big context, separate quota), then Claude light. Never local: the taster's SHIP can auto-merge, and a 9b model cannot open files or review a diff (J50, J89).
menuWhy.review: A reviewer is never the builder: the sous chef moves the builder's model family down for check and review steps (code, not a note). Gemini mid first (big context, separate Google quota), then Claude light.
menuWhy.write: Prose: Claude mid, then the Google-plan copy, Gemini mid, with local as the free fallback.
menuWhy.quick: Short questions and summaries do not need a cloud cook: local first, cheap cloud only if it is down.
menuWhy.big: Huge context goes to Gemini strong first; the others cannot hold it.
menuWhy.private: Private orders never leave this PC: local models only.
menuWhy.talk: Chat with Jordan keeps Claude mid for tone and judgment, with fallbacks down the list.

_prices: API-equivalent $ per million tokens [input, output], matched against the model name, for cooks that don't report a price (Gemini). Estimates only.
_standing: Night orders run at 4-5 am: Windows Update restarts this PC around 2:15 am (10/12, 10/17), which stopped the old 1-2 am runs.
_nightInspection: TD-EH-03b: the night inspection runs scripts/night-inspection.ps1 (recheck-main -All -SkipUnchanged, bounded) on this PC at 2 am, also while the Yard is paused (a watcher order). Off by default; the Owner turns it on with one line in the live kitchen.json: "standingOn": ["night inspection"],
_standingPaused: Paused 2026-10-20 until Phase 2 (Demo Project, release Tue Oct 27) ends: the kitchen's self-improvement research had filed ~105 ideas. Move these back into standing to resume.
